description: List every macroeconomic indicator FXMacroData publishes for a currency, with units, frequency, and coverage/freshness metadata. Returns the exact `indicator` slug strings used across FXMacroData indicator, calendar, and prediction endpoints. Rows whose `coverage` is stale, partial, or unavailable are not suitable for real-time carry or inflation analysis. Supported currencies (lowercase 3-letter codes): AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CNH, CNY, DKK, EUR, GBP, HUF, ILS, JPY, KRW, MYR, NGN, NOK, NZD, PEN, SEK, THB, TWD, USD. Other views, all free: `forecasts` shows which publishers forecast which indicators and how far each archive runs (no forecast values); `fx_sources` lists official FX reference-rate publishers; `fx_universe` lists the pairs each one covers; `sources` returns a persisted source definition by its metadata `sha256`. Access: free for every currency, no API key required.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Required for the indicators and sources views; optional filter for the others. Supported: AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CNH, CNY, DKK, EUR, GBP, HUF, ILS, JPY, KRW, MYR, NGN, NOK, NZD, PEN, SEK, THB, TWD, USD.

include_capabilities.description: Include machine-readable indicator capabilities when the API supports them, such as supported transformations, history availability, and release-calendar linkage.

include_coverage.description: Include coverage/freshness rows with latest_available_date, coverage_quality, has_recent_data, and recent_observation_count. These rows show whether an indicator series is current enough for analysis.

indicator.description: Optional indicator slug that narrows the result to that one catalogue entry and its coverage row, for example `core_inflation`. Useful when the candidate series is already known; omit it to list every indicator.

sha256.description: sources only: the metadata SHA256 from a catalogue row.

source.description: fx_universe only: official source id filter.

view.description: indicators (default): the indicator catalogue. forecasts: forecast coverage by publisher. fx_sources / fx_universe: official FX reference-rate publishers and the pairs they cover. sources: one persisted source definition, by `sha256`.
